title: Juste parfaite
body:
Cette appli permet aux plus désorganisés de se structurer et construire des journées adaptées en un clin d'oeil.
J'ai pu planifier des habitudes et m'y tenir, tout en souplesse. Elle est esthétique, adaptable à l'infini, et redonne plaisir à l'organisation de séances de travail en profondeur, alternées par des sorties et la planification de tout ce qui rempli vos journées. En un coup d'oeil on prend conscience du temps qu'on accorde à chaque sphère de notre vie, et du temps qu'on gagne pour le "redistribuer".
La synchro avec les différents agendas permet, pour moi qui le partage avec mon mari et mes enfants, de voir ce qui sera à remanier pour cadrer à nos horaires à tous. Bref. Parfait pour moi.

title: Useful, life-changing and simple to use
body: I rarely purchase the premium version of apps, but this one was so worth it! It helps me stay productive and feel satisfied every day after completing each task. I’d like to add one suggestion though : there should be a way to move a task AND all the next tasks by x minutes at the same time. Basically, sometimes I miscalculate the time it’d take to do something and I need to change the time it ended, however it overlaps with the next task. And it’s annoying to change the time of each task that follows. So it would be nice to have an option to move a task and all the ones that follow it at the same time (and maybe exclude sleep time if moving several days worth of tasks at the same time is too much)

title: Amazing but need some enhancements :-)
body:
I just purchased the pro version cause since first second I liked how easy and straightforward the app is. I would like to suggest to add some features to make the app even better:
1. Add search bar to inbox: when we have a lot of tasks coming from legacy apps, it might be complicated to scroll down on all of them. And yes, Google made us live the search bar
2. Add possibility to connect to mail boxes, this is helpful when we need to schedule some emails for to do later (amazing feature available in Microsoft ToDo(
3. Add possibility to use own icons, and even better images, this is a nice to have but not really big matter for productivity 

All the best to Structured team. One of apps that I think suggest to my teams to use for personal and professional use :-)

title: Nice!
body:
After months of searching and buying planners which were not worth it, I finally think I found the one! 

As it’s still quite new, there is still room for improvement, but I think it has a lot of potential. 

Some ideas of what I’m searching in a planner
- A habit tracker would be handy. Something very simple in the form of a table, where you can just fill in the habit, the days, and a checkbox for when it’s done

- A place to plan workouts. For example you can create a task called workout & link it to the specific workout (where this would then be a page with the workout explained, like a notes page) OR if you want to keep it simple (Which is sometimes better), just the option to have notes

title: Nice app! Works really good
body:

The reason I didn’t take premium yet is because it can be updated a little bit, in my opinion.  

For example, when creating a task, the « x » to close it doesn’t react, it would be even better that when you press create task that the window closes automatically. 
It would be even cooler if it could track habbits, and how much you complete during the day, etc. 
The color’s you add, would be nice to be able to judt re-organise them, instead of having to delete and add them again. There’s also only 1 colored theme and 1 blank theme? 
A scoreboard or something to encourage to check your schedule?
 These are just idea’s 😊

It could definitely level up, in my opinion. 

Kind regards!
